name: Casatejada (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casatejada (a saint on yellow and a church on green).
history: The arms and the flag of Casatejada were approved by the Order of 14 June 1993 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 22 June 1993, after the municipal council's approval on 31 July 1992.
